name: Awakura Miyako
source:
Kouji's older sister. She dotes on her brother, though it feels more like she treats him as a childhood friend. She becomes conscious of him after noticing he hides her underwear.

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/axh/axh_chr.html#miyako]official site[/url]]
